description: Rules for using tokens. Category names are real keys of token-catalog.json counts.byCategory and slot names are real keys of the PageSpec `tokens` object, so extraction/verify_all.py resolves both. A PageSpec names a token by its catalog path; schema/semantic_validate.py rejects anything else (TOKEN_* rules in compatibility/graph.json).

rawValueRestrictions.color: forbidden in primitives/, components/, sections/, templates/ and every PageSpec token slot: foundation colours are referenced by token path, never written as hex / rgb() / hsl() / a colour name
rawValueRestrictions.semanticColor: forbidden in primitives/, components/, sections/, templates/ and every PageSpec token slot: semantic colours (surface.*, text.*, border.*, line.*, marker.*) are referenced by token path; a theme resolves them
rawValueRestrictions.fontFamily: forbidden in primitives/, components/, sections/, templates/ and every PageSpec token slot: font families are referenced by token path; no raw family name or stack (the source fonts are licence-required, see assets/asset-roles.json)
rawValueRestrictions.fontWeight: forbidden in primitives/, components/, sections/, templates/ and every PageSpec token slot: weights are referenced by token path
rawValueRestrictions.typography: forbidden in primitives/, components/, sections/, templates/ and every PageSpec token slot: type scale and roles (size, line-height, tracking) exist only as typography.role.* tokens; no loose font-size values
rawValueRestrictions.spacing: forbidden in primitives/, components/, sections/, templates/ and every PageSpec token slot: spacing is referenced by token path; no px / rem / em / vh / vw / % / calc() written into a PageSpec or contract
rawValueRestrictions.radius: forbidden in primitives/, components/, sections/, templates/ and every PageSpec token slot: radii are referenced by token path
rawValueRestrictions.breakpoint: forbidden in primitives/, components/, sections/, templates/ and every PageSpec token slot: breakpoints are referenced by token path
rawValueRestrictions.layer: forbidden in primitives/, components/, sections/, templates/ and every PageSpec token slot: z-index layering is referenced by token path
rawValueRestrictions.iconSize: forbidden in primitives/, components/, sections/, templates/ and every PageSpec token slot: icon sizes are referenced by token path
rawValueRestrictions.motion: forbidden in primitives/, components/, sections/, templates/ and every PageSpec token slot: durations, easings, delays and offsets are referenced by token path; patterns come from tokens/llm/motion-patterns.json
rawValueRestrictions.layout: forbidden in primitives/, components/, sections/, templates/ and every PageSpec token slot: widths and columns are referenced by token path
rawValueRestrictions.component: forbidden in primitives/, components/, sections/, templates/ and every PageSpec token slot: component tokens are referenced by token path

rules.referenceSyntax: {path.to.token} resolving against tokens/ (tokens/tokens_lib.py); in a PageSpec a bare catalog path, e.g. semantic.surface.page
rules.rawLintCoverage: Hex colours, rgb()/hsl() and named colours in every string of every PageSpec example (copy included; schema/semantic_validate.py checks the token slots themselves on every spec, whatever the example)

pageSpecTokenSlots.$comment: Every token a PageSpec can name. `tokens.*` slots are keys of the PageSpec `tokens` object (closed in schema/pagespec.schema.json); webglClear is the one pre-existing token field (layer.webgl-object content.clearColorToken). `allow` is the closed list of catalog paths a slot accepts. `kind` is the catalog category the slot expects.

text.purpose: Body text colour; must contrast with the surface slot.

fontDisplay.purpose: Display (condensed) family; shares the sans licence role.

sectionPadding.purpose: Vertical rhythm of a section; a token, never a measured length.

webglClear.purpose: Clear colour of the fixed WebGL canvas (foundation colour, not theme-resolved).

themeRules.$comment: Pinned in extraction/verify_all.py (PINNED_TOKEN_RULES) as well as here.
themeRules.themeMustExist: spec.theme must be a key of token-catalog.json themes (tokens/themes/*.json).
themeRules.themeResolved: A slot marked themeResolved may only name a semantic token the declared theme resolves (catalog themes.<theme>.semanticTokens).
themeRules.contrast: The text slot, resolved through the theme, must reach minTextContrast (WCAG 2.x relative-luminance ratio) against the surface slot. This rejects text.primary on surface.buttonHover (identical colour, ratio 1) and text.onButtonHover on surface.page (identical colour).
themeRules.fontAssetRole: A font slot's token assetRole (typography.json) must equal the assetRole of its assetField in the PageSpec (fonts.sans, fonts.mono).

notGenerationApprovedReason: Exactly the catalog tokens whose token file marks them status 'unused' or 'effectively-invisible' (derived and compared by extraction/verify_all.py): they exist in the source CSS but never render, so a generator must not build on them.
overrides: A PageSpec carries no per-instance style or token override. It names a closed set of page-level tokens in `tokens` (and clearColorToken); styling inside a section stays owned by the section/component contracts. Nothing else in a PageSpec can carry a colour, length or font.
